# School Time student sprite source

These student layers are sourced from the Liberated Pixel Cup Universal LPC Spritesheet Character Generator:
https://github.com/LiberatedPixelCup/Universal-LPC-Spritesheet-Character-Generator

Pinned source revision: 4963a69795255fb15a934c47f478a8bdcf3668f5

Used layers:
- child body walk cycle
- white child shirt walk cycle
- dark-blue child pants walk cycle
- dark-blue child skirt walk cycle

The upstream project states that LPC artwork uses per-asset licenses including CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, OGA-BY, and GPL. The complete upstream CREDITS.csv is included beside these assets. School Time must retain the applicable attribution/license information for the selected artwork.
